svg.title: Kconfig channel model: from menuconfig to relays
svg.desc: Example: a 2-channel board. Raising the count uses the next slots; nothing else changes.
svg.text: Kconfig channel model: from menuconfig to relays
Example: a 2-channel board. Raising the count uses the next slots; nothing else changes.
IN1 relay GPIO: 26 · IN2 relay GPIO: 27 · IN3 … IN14: prompts hidden, defaults still defined
defined but unused: the 14 safe pins as defaults, ready when the count grows
✗ any fails → build stops with a message
per used slot and hands them
to the state machine as a bank.
